overview:
Astute Connect is an India-based expert network introduced by Astute Analytica in September 2023. Its company LinkedIn page lists Noida, Uttar Pradesh as headquarters. The current website describes Astute Analytica as an affiliated research and intelligence firm and offers expert consultations, custom recruitment, surveys, and other primary research services.

The website reports 400,000+ experts, 500+ clients, and expert access across 100+ countries for the combined Astute Connect and Astute Analytica ecosystem. These are company-stated figures, not independently verified standalone Astute Connect totals. A January 2026 press release claimed over 4 million experts; the current profile uses the lower website figure with its broader ecosystem scope.

The company describes a managed process covering project scoping, expert sourcing, screening, scheduling, and agreed deliverables. Its January 12, 2026 announcement reported expanded expert engagement capabilities for consulting, investment, and corporate strategy clients.

history.narrative: Astute Analytica publicly introduced Astute Connect on September 11, 2023. Subsequent company releases described AI-assisted matching in September 2024, a market-sizing report in August 2025, and expanded expert engagement capabilities in January 2026. These announcements establish what the company reported at those dates; they do not independently validate its technology or scale.

timeline.event: Astute Analytica introduced Astute Connect in a September 11 launch announcement.
In a September 18 release, the company described AI algorithms for client requirement analysis and expert matching.
On August 1, announced The Expert Network Market Sizing 2025, which estimated the 2024 market at over $2.52 billion; this is the company’s estimate.
On January 12, announced expanded expert engagement capabilities for consulting, investment, and corporate strategy clients.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: The company offers one-on-one and group expert calls, with its team sourcing, screening, and scheduling practitioners against the client brief.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Expert Recruitment
servicesDetailed.description: The website offers recruitment for advisory roles, project engagements, and specialist positions. Its process page describes sourcing and screening against each brief.

servicesDetailed.name: Primary Research
servicesDetailed.description: The company advertises in-depth interviews, focus groups, B2B and B2C surveys, respondent recruitment, retail audits, and customer experience research.

servicesDetailed.name: Transcripts and Insight Summaries
servicesDetailed.description: The company offers transcripts and summaries as scoped add-ons, plus synthesis across multiple calls and a searchable archive of a client’s engagements. It says deliverables are exclusive to the commissioning client.

aiPlatform.narrative: In its September 18, 2024 press release, Astute Connect said AI algorithms analyzed client requirements and matched experts. These are dated company claims, without independent technical validation. The current process page describes research-team sourcing and screening; the June 2026 AI article discusses industry practices without documenting a new Astute Connect product launch.
features: AI analysis of client requirements (company-stated, September 2024)

complianceExtended.narrative: Astute Connect publishes a company-described framework covering screening, conflicts, MNPI restrictions, confidentiality, and engagement records. These are policy statements; their execution has not been independently audited in this review.

clientFit.narrative: The company markets its services to consulting firms, private equity and venture capital funds, hedge funds, and corporate strategy teams. The following use cases reflect that stated positioning.
segments: Consulting teams conducting sector research and market mapping
Corporate strategy teams evaluating market entry and competitors

strengths: Company-described research partnership with Astute Analytica
Company-described senior project attention from scoping through delivery
Company-stated global expert access across 100+ countries
Company-offered interviews, surveys, and structured research deliverables
caveats: Published expert and client totals cover the combined Astute ecosystem; standalone Astute Connect scale is not established.
The current 400,000+ ecosystem expert figure differs from the January 2026 release’s claim of over 4 million; the company does not explain the difference on the reviewed pages.
Public AI implementation claims retained here date to September 2024 and lack independent validation.
Pricing requires a scoped quote; lower cost than competing providers is not established.
Compliance controls are company-described; this review does not establish their operational effectiveness.
